race.credit_rule: earliest durable claim owns ordinal semantic credit; later worker must pivot or retain only explicitly noncounting replication

ordinals.title: feat: comprehensive email system upgrade
ordinals.finding: Expanded read-only-style email integration into broad mutating capability: send/reply/reply-all/forward/delete/spam/draft plus CC/BCC and attachments. High-authority effect surface requires explicit capability, confirmation and effect-receipt semantics.

ordinals.title: fix: email reply writes in user's language and sounds like the user
ordinals.finding: Ghostwriter prompt intentionally removed AI markers/disclaimers and mirrored user instruction language. Preserve as historical UX/policy lineage, not current safety authority.

ordinals.title: fix: uncensored email replies - Frank writes exactly what user asks
ordinals.finding: Prompt explicitly demanded no refusals or safety mediation. Historical evidence of a dangerous coupling: generative style prompt was allowed to define authority policy for an external-effect channel.

ordinals.title: fix: email reply context overflow - compact identity + body extraction
ordinals.finding: Reduced prompt overflow by shrinking identity context and extracting a bounded email essence. Supports selective context assembly rather than injecting full global identity into every narrow task.

ordinals.title: fix: sync local mbox after IMAP delete/spam + popup focus
ordinals.finding: Remote IMAP mutation and local Thunderbird mbox were separate replicas; code added explicit local synchronization after remote delete/spam. Demonstrates replica convergence obligation after external effects.

ordinals.title: fix: popup scroll isolation + focus for text input
ordinals.finding: X11 overrideredirect focus/scroll handling is implementation-relevant but yields no new cross-architecture mechanism beyond existing UI event-isolation knowledge.

ordinals.title: fix: email body sanitization + visible reply intent view
ordinals.finding: Expanded sanitization for tracking URLs, base64 artifacts, Unicode/box noise, boilerplate and injection-like lines before display/LLM use. Historical evidence for a distinct untrusted-content normalization layer.

ordinals.title: fix: UI-first email delete/spam - instantly remove card from list
ordinals.finding: UI removed emails before IMAP confirmation and the change removed rollback branches present in the predecessor. Visible state could therefore assert success while the external effect failed.

ordinals.title: fix: deleted emails now disappear immediately from card list
ordinals.finding: Immediate local blacklist hid deleted/spammed mail but explicitly rolled back the optimistic state on IMAP failure/not-found. Provides the safer predecessor against which k375 is a regression.

ordinals.title: feat: reply asks user intent before generating AI draft
ordinals.finding: Inserted an explicit user-intent step before drafting. Supports separating user decision/intent capture from model generation for high-impact communications.

ordinals.title: fix: email body formatting, instant delete, AI-generated replies
ordinals.finding: Combined richer sanitization, larger display context and AI-generated replies. Important lineage for separating display context from bounded model context.

ordinals.title: feat: email popup window with send, reply, draft, attachments
ordinals.finding: Introduced SMTP OAuth2 send, IMAP draft/read-state mutation, attachments and Thunderbird fallback. This is the point where email becomes an effect-capable subsystem rather than passive context.

ordinals.title: fix: broken email functions in proactive_controller
ordinals.finding: Caller assumed nonexistent function, unsupported parameter and wrong return shape. Cross-service semantic contracts had drifted without type/schema enforcement.

ordinals.title: feat: add frank-overlay.service template to install.sh
ordinals.finding: Multiple components referenced frank-overlay.service although installer never created it. Architecture references and deployment manifests were inconsistent.

ordinals.title: chore: install.sh configures GNOME desktop to match Frank deployment
ordinals.finding: Installer mutated host GNOME appearance/dock state. Preserve as platform-specific deployment lineage and portability/least-surprise caution, not core cognitive semantics.

ordinals.title: fix: add missing system deps (libzbar0, maim) to install.sh
ordinals.finding: Runtime features depended on native packages absent from installer; switched OpenCV to headless variant. Reproducible deployment requires explicit native/runtime dependency closure and unnecessary GUI deps should be avoided.

measurement_boundary: No historical performance/success claim in these commits was independently reproduced in this semantic pass; this manifest records repository-history code evidence and lineage only.
